problems.title: Graph Node Count
problems.description: Return the number of distinct vertices in an edge list. Vertices are numbered from 0 and edges use the notation shown in the examples. Unless stated otherwise, repeated edges do not add new vertices.
problems.input_format: The input is a whitespace-separated edge record; directed edges use >, undirected edges use -, and weights use :.
problems.output_format: Print the requested number, boolean, ordering, or sequence on one line.
problems.constraints: 1 <= vertices <= 100000; 0 <= edges <= 200000; weights fit signed 32-bit integers.
hints: Choose BFS for unweighted distance and DFS for components or cycle discovery.
For weighted graphs, select the algorithm whose assumptions match edge weights and direction.
